note: 术语表（英文模式用 def_en、name_en、label_en；标题用 en）：每条一两句白话，加“在本站哪里看到它”。group 对应资源库的主题 id；按 A–Z 排序时用 en 的首字母。数字都按本站用的模型（Qwen3-0.6B / Qwen3-VL-2B / Qwen3-4B）写。

terms.def: 模型读写文字的最小单位。Qwen3 的词表有 151,936 个词元，一个词元可能是一个汉字、一个词，或者英文单词的一截。
terms.def_en: The smallest unit of text a model reads and writes. Qwen3's vocabulary has 151,936 tokens; a token can be one Chinese character, a whole word, or a piece of an English word.

where.label: 推理 · 点选输入法

terms.def: 把文字切成词元的过程。Qwen3 用字节级 BPE：从单个字节出发，把训练语料里最常挨在一起的一对反复合并成新词元。
terms.def_en: Cutting text into tokens. Qwen3 uses byte-level BPE: start from single bytes and keep merging the pair that most often appears together in the training corpus into a new token.

where.label: 推理 · D2 结构 · 读入

terms.def: 查表：每个词元编号对应表里的一行 1024 个数，这一行就是它进入模型时的向量。
terms.def_en: A table lookup: each token ID maps to one row of 1,024 numbers, and that row is the vector the token enters the model as.

where.label: 推理 · D2 结构 · 嵌入

terms.def: 贯穿全部 28 层的那条向量。注意力和前馈网络的输出都是“加”回去的，所以每层只是在它上面添一点东西。
terms.def_en: The vector that runs through all 28 layers. Attention and the feed-forward network add their outputs back onto it, so each layer only adds a little.

where.label: 推理 · D3 层塔

terms.def: 由“注意力 + 前馈网络”一层层堆起来的神经网络结构，2017 年提出。今天的大语言模型几乎都是它的“只用解码器”版本。
terms.def_en: A neural network built from layers of "attention + feed-forward network", introduced in 2017. Almost every large language model today is its decoder-only version.

where.label: 推理 · D2 结构

terms.def: 每个词元按“相关程度”从前面的词元那里取信息：先打分，再用 softmax 变成权重，最后加权求和。
terms.def_en: Each token pulls information from earlier tokens according to how relevant they are: score them, turn the scores into weights with softmax, then take the weighted sum.

where.label: 推理 · D5 算子

terms.def: 每个词元算出三个向量：Q 用来提问，K 用来被匹配，V 是被取走的内容。打分 = Q·K ÷ √128，Qwen3-0.6B 每个头是 128 维。
terms.def_en: Each token computes three vectors: Q asks, K gets matched, V is the content that gets taken. Score = Q·K ÷ √128; each head in Qwen3-0.6B is 128-dimensional.

where.label: 推理 · D5 算子 · Q·K·V

terms.def: 同时有好几组 Q、K、V，各看各的，最后拼起来。Qwen3-0.6B 每层 16 个查询头，各自的分工很不一样。
terms.def_en: Several sets of Q, K and V at once, each looking at its own thing, concatenated at the end. Qwen3-0.6B has 16 query heads per layer, each with a very different job.

where.label: 推理 · D5 算子（16 个头可切换）

terms.def: 几个查询头共用一组 K、V。Qwen3-0.6B 的 16 个查询头只配 8 组键值头，KV 缓存因此省一半，效果几乎不变。
terms.def_en: Several query heads share one set of K and V. Qwen3-0.6B's 16 query heads get only 8 key-value heads, which halves the KV cache at almost no cost in quality.

where.label: 推理 · D4 一层之内

terms.def: 每个位置只能看见自己和前面的词元：后面位置的打分在 softmax 之前被设成负无穷，生成时未来还不存在。
terms.def_en: Each position can see only itself and earlier tokens: scores for later positions are set to minus infinity before softmax. When generating, the future doesn't exist yet.

where.label: 推理 · D5 算子 · softmax

terms.def: 很多头把一大半注意力放在第一个词元上，哪怕它毫无内容。softmax 要求权重加起来等于 1，没东西可看时总得找个地方“停车”。
terms.def_en: Many heads put most of their attention on the first token, even though it carries no content. Softmax forces the weights to add up to 1, so when there's nothing to look at the attention has to "park" somewhere.

where.label: 推理 · D5 算子 · 注意力头
本页 · 动手试试 ③

terms.def: 按词元的位置把 Q、K 旋转一个角度（Qwen3 的 θ = 10⁶），两个向量的点积于是只取决于它们相隔多远。
terms.def_en: Rotates Q and K by an angle that depends on the token's position (Qwen3 uses θ = 10⁶), so the dot product of two vectors depends only on how far apart they are.

where.label: 推理 · D5 算子 · Q·K·V

terms.def: 把向量除以自己的均方根，再乘一组可学习的系数。每次进入注意力和前馈之前都做一次，让几十层叠下去数值也不爆炸。
terms.def_en: Divide a vector by its own root mean square, then multiply by a set of learned weights. Done before every attention and feed-forward block, so the numbers don't blow up across dozens of layers.

where.label: 推理 · D4 一层之内

terms.def: 每层注意力之后的第二部分：对每个位置单独做“升维 → 激活 → 降维”，不同位置之间不交换信息。
terms.def_en: The second half of each layer, after attention: expand → activate → project back down, for each position separately, with no information passed between positions.

where.label: 推理 · D4 一层之内

terms.def: 带门控的前馈网络：同时算两组数 g 和 u，输出 SiLU(g) × u，g 像阀门决定放多少信号过去。Qwen3-0.6B 每层有 3072 个这样的神经元。
terms.def_en: A gated feed-forward network: compute two sets of numbers g and u and output SiLU(g) × u, where g acts like a valve deciding how much signal gets through. Qwen3-0.6B has 3,072 of these neurons per layer.

where.label: 推理 · D5 算子 · 神经元阵列

terms.def: 模型里绝大部分的计算：输出的每个数，都是输入的一行和权重的一列逐项相乘再相加。
terms.def_en: Most of the computation in a model: every output number is a row of the input times a column of the weights, multiplied term by term and summed.

where.label: 推理 · D6 一次乘加
多模态 · D5 一次乘加

terms.def: 16 位浮点数：1 位符号、8 位指数、7 位尾数。数值范围和 32 位浮点数一样大，只是精度低一些。
terms.def_en: A 16-bit float: 1 sign bit, 8 exponent bits, 7 mantissa bits. Same range as a 32-bit float, just less precision.

where.label: 推理 · D7 比特
训练 · D4 写回的比特

terms.def: 输出头给词表里每个词元的原始打分，可正可负，还没有变成概率。
terms.def_en: The raw scores the output head gives every token in the vocabulary — positive or negative, not yet probabilities.

where.label: 推理 · D2 结构 · 输出头

terms.def: 把一组打分变成加起来等于 1 的概率：每个分数先取指数，再除以它们的总和。注意力和输出头都用它。
terms.def_en: Turns a set of scores into probabilities that add up to 1: exponentiate each score, then divide by the total. Attention and the output head both use it.

where.label: 推理 · D5 算子 · softmax
训练 · D4 交叉熵

terms.def: 抽签前先把打分除以温度：温度低，高分更占优势、回答更保守；温度高，分布更平、回答更随机。本站推理页用 0.7。
terms.def_en: Scores are divided by the temperature before the draw: low temperature favours the top scores and answers play it safe; high temperature flattens the distribution and answers get more random. This site's inference page uses 0.7.

where.label: 推理 · D2 结构 · 采样

terms.def: 抽签前的两道截断：只留概率最高的前 k 个（本站 20），再从高到低累加概率，凑够 p（本站 0.8）就把后面的丢掉。
terms.def_en: Two cuts before the draw: keep only the k most likely tokens (20 on this site), then add up probabilities from the top and drop everything after the total reaches p (0.8 on this site).

where.label: 推理 · D2 结构 · 采样
本页 · 动手试试 ②

terms.def: 一次只生成一个词元，把它接到输入末尾，再生成下一个。流畅的回答就是这样一个词一个词“滚”出来的。
terms.def_en: Generate one token at a time, append it to the input, then generate the next. A fluent answer "rolls out" one word at a time like this.

where.label: 推理 · D1 黑箱

terms.def: 生成开始时把整段提示一次性并行算完；之后每一步只需要为新的一个位置计算。
terms.def_en: At the start of generation the whole prompt is computed at once, in parallel; after that each step only computes the one new position.

where.label: 推理 · D2 结构 · 嵌入

terms.def: 把每层算过的 K、V 存起来，生成下一个词元时直接复用，不必把前面的词重算一遍。代价是显存随上下文变长而增加。
terms.def_en: Store the K and V every layer has already computed and reuse them for the next token instead of recomputing the earlier words. The cost: memory grows as the context gets longer.

where.label: 推理 · D3 层塔
智能体 · D3 上下文（缓存复用）

terms.def: 把多轮对话拼成一串带特殊词元的文字：<|im_start|>user … <|im_end|>。模型其实只是在续写这串文字。
terms.def_en: Turns a multi-turn conversation into one string with special tokens: <|im_start|>user … <|im_end|>. The model is really just continuing this string.

where.label: 推理 · D2 结构 · 读入
训练 · D3 套聊天模板
where.label_en: Training · D3 Applying the chat template

terms.def: 最后一层之后的一个 1024 × 151936 的矩阵，把向量变成每个词元的 logits。Qwen3-0.6B 的输出头和嵌入表共用同一块权重。
terms.def_en: A 1024 × 151936 matrix after the last layer that turns the vector into logits for every token. In Qwen3-0.6B the output head shares its weights with the embedding table.

where.label: 推理 · D2 结构 · 输出头

terms.def: 在海量文本上练“猜下一个词元”。训练页的小模型就是在 990 万字的唐宋诗上从零预训练的。
terms.def_en: Practising "guess the next token" on a huge amount of text. The training page's small model was pretrained from scratch on 9.9 million characters of Tang and Song poetry.

where.label: 训练 · D1 预训练全程

terms.def: 损失 = −ln（模型给正确答案的概率）。正确答案给得越低，罚得越重；给 100% 时损失为 0。
terms.def_en: Loss = −ln(the probability the model gave the right answer). The lower that probability, the bigger the penalty; at 100% the loss is 0.

where.label: 训练 · D4 一个位置的交叉熵
where.label_en: Training · D4 Cross-entropy at one position

terms.def: 损失对每个权重的偏导数：告诉你把这个权重往哪个方向、改多少，能让损失下降得最快。
terms.def_en: The partial derivative of the loss with respect to each weight: it tells you which way, and how much, to change that weight to lower the loss fastest.

where.label: 训练 · D3 反向

terms.def: 用链式法则从损失出发，一层层往回算出所有权重的梯度。算一次的代价大约是前向的两倍。
terms.def_en: Use the chain rule to work back from the loss, layer by layer, to every weight's gradient. One pass costs roughly twice a forward pass.

where.label: 训练 · D2 一步之内

terms.def: 每一步沿梯度走多远。训练页的小模型先用 200 步把学习率升到 3e-3，再按余弦曲线慢慢降到 3e-4。
terms.def_en: How far each step moves along the gradient. The training page's small model warms the learning rate up to 3e-3 over 200 steps, then lowers it along a cosine curve to 3e-4.

where.label: 训练 · D1 学习率曲线

terms.def: 最常用的优化器：用梯度的滑动平均（一阶矩）和梯度平方的滑动平均（二阶矩）决定每个权重这一步走多远，权重衰减单独做。
terms.def_en: The most common optimizer: a running average of the gradient (first moment) and of the squared gradient (second moment) decide how far each weight moves this step; weight decay is applied separately.

where.label: 训练 · D3 更新

terms.def: 把损失看成权重空间里的地形，训练就是往低处走。训练页在检查点轨迹的两个主成分平面上画了 41 × 41 的地形。
terms.def_en: Think of the loss as terrain over weight space; training walks downhill. The training page draws a 41 × 41 landscape on the plane of the checkpoint trajectory's two principal components.

where.label: 训练 · D1 损失地形

terms.def: 拿“问题 → 理想回答”的对话继续训练，提示部分不算损失，只对回答算。训练页在 Qwen3-0.6B 上真实走了三步。
terms.def_en: Keep training on "question → ideal answer" conversations, with loss counted only on the answer, not the prompt. The training page runs three real steps of this on Qwen3-0.6B.

where.label: 训练 · Qwen3 三步 SFT

terms.def: 先用人类的偏好训练一个奖励模型给回答打分，再用强化学习让模型多产出高分的回答。
terms.def_en: First train a reward model on human preferences to score answers, then use reinforcement learning to make the model produce more high-scoring answers.

where.label: 训练 · D0 流水线（示意）

terms.def: 直接用“好回答 / 差回答”成对的数据调模型：提高好回答相对差回答的概率，不需要单独的奖励模型和强化学习。
terms.def_en: Tune the model directly on pairs of good and bad answers: raise the probability of the good one relative to the bad one, with no separate reward model and no reinforcement learning.

where.label: 训练 · D0 流水线（DPO 一例）

terms.def: 把图片切成小块、每块当成一个词元交给 Transformer 的看图网络。Qwen3-VL-2B 的视觉部分是 24 层 ViT。
terms.def_en: A vision network that cuts an image into small patches and gives each one to a Transformer as a token. The vision part of Qwen3-VL-2B is a 24-layer ViT.

where.label: 多模态 · D3 逐层 · ViT
where.label_en: Multimodal · D3 Layer by layer · ViT

terms.def: 图片被切成的 16 × 16 像素小块。Qwen3-VL 把单张图复制成 2 帧，所以一个图块是 3 通道 × 2 帧 × 16 × 16 = 1536 个数。
terms.def_en: The 16 × 16-pixel squares an image is cut into. Qwen3-VL duplicates a single image into 2 frames, so one patch is 3 channels × 2 frames × 16 × 16 = 1,536 numbers.

where.label: 多模态 · D3 切块
多模态 · D5 一次乘加

terms.def: 把相邻 2 × 2 个图块的特征拼起来再压成一个向量，视觉词元的数量变成四分之一，再拼进对话。
terms.def_en: Concatenate the features of each 2 × 2 group of neighbouring patches and compress them into one vector, cutting the number of visual tokens to a quarter before they join the conversation.

where.label: 多模态 · D3 2×2 合并

terms.def: 多模态版的旋转位置编码：每个词元有（时间, 高, 宽）三个位置。文字的三个数相同，图块按自己所在的行和列。
terms.def_en: RoPE for multimodal input: each token has three positions (time, height, width). For text all three are the same; image patches use their own row and column.

where.label: 多模态 · D3 M-RoPE

terms.def: 不只用视觉编码器最后一层的输出，还把中间几层的特征加进语言模型的前几层，让细节信息也能传进去。
terms.def_en: Instead of using only the vision encoder's last layer, features from several middle layers are also added into the language model's first few layers, so fine detail gets through too.

where.label: 多模态 · D4 一层之内（DeepStack 注入）
where.label_en: Multimodal · D4 Inside a layer (DeepStack injection)

terms.def: 把生成某个字时对每个图块的注意力画回原图上。实测 Qwen3-VL-2B 第 16–26 层最会“看对地方”。
terms.def_en: The attention paid to each image patch while generating a word, painted back onto the image. Measured on Qwen3-VL-2B, layers 16–26 are best at looking in the right place.

where.label: 多模态 · 鼠标放在回答的字上
where.label_en: Multimodal · Hover over a word of the answer

terms.def: 模型 + 工具 + 循环：模型说出要做的动作，外面的程序去执行，再把结果接回对话，直到任务完成。
terms.def_en: Model + tools + loop: the model says what action to take, an outside program carries it out, and the result goes back into the conversation, until the task is done.

where.label: 智能体 · D2 循环

terms.def: 模型按约定格式写出要调用的函数和参数（Qwen3 用 <tool_call> 包着一段 JSON），由程序解析后真的去执行。
terms.def_en: The model writes out the function to call and its arguments in an agreed format (Qwen3 wraps a JSON snippet in <tool_call>), and a program parses it and actually runs it.

where.label: 智能体 · D4 生成

terms.def: 让模型交替“想一步、做一步”：先写推理，再调用工具，用工具返回的结果修正下一步的推理。
terms.def_en: Have the model alternate between thinking a step and taking a step: write out its reasoning, call a tool, and use what comes back to correct the next step of reasoning.

where.label: 智能体 · D2 循环

terms.def: 模型一次能看到的最多词元数。智能体每一圈都把整段对话重新喂给模型，上下文越滚越长，迟早要考虑塞什么、丢什么。
terms.def_en: The most tokens a model can see at once. An agent feeds the whole conversation back in every turn, so the context keeps growing and sooner or later you have to choose what to keep and what to drop.

where.label: 智能体 · D3 上下文

terms.def: 隔离的运行环境。智能体页的每条命令都在断网、只能写 /work 的 bubblewrap 沙箱里执行，跑坏了也不影响外面。
terms.def_en: An isolated environment. Every command on the agent page runs in a bubblewrap sandbox with no network that can only write to /work, so nothing outside can break.

where.label: 智能体 · D1 屏幕

terms.def: 学会“环境下一步会变成什么样”的模型。有了它，智能体可以先在想象里把动作预演一遍，再决定怎么做。
terms.def_en: A model that has learned "what the environment will look like next". With one, an agent can rehearse an action in its imagination before deciding what to do.

where.label: 世界模型 · 在梦里玩
where.label_en: World Models · Play in the dream

terms.def: 编码器把一帧画面压成几个数，解码器再把它画回来；VAE 额外要求这些数接近高斯分布，所以可以随机采样出新画面。
terms.def_en: An encoder squeezes a frame into a few numbers and a decoder draws it back; a VAE also requires those numbers to stay close to a Gaussian, so you can sample new frames at random.

where.label: 世界模型 · 在梦里玩
where.label_en: World Models · Play in the dream

terms.def: 不能直接观测、由模型自己学出来的压缩表示，比如 VAE 把一整帧画面压成的那几个数。
terms.def_en: A compressed representation the model learns by itself and that can't be observed directly — like the few numbers a VAE squeezes a whole frame into.

where.label: 世界模型 · 在梦里玩
where.label_en: World Models · Play in the dream

terms.def: 带记忆的网络，一步步读入序列、更新自己的隐状态。世界模型里用它根据当前潜变量和动作预测下一步。
terms.def_en: A network with memory that reads a sequence step by step, updating its hidden state. In a world model it predicts the next step from the current latent variables and the action.

where.label: 世界模型 · 在梦里玩
where.label_en: World Models · Play in the dream

terms.def: 把某一层的中间向量直接接到最终的 RMSNorm 和输出头上，读出模型“此刻会说什么”，看答案在第几层成形。
terms.def_en: Wire one layer's intermediate vector straight into the final RMSNorm and output head to read what the model "would say right now", and see which layer the answer takes shape in.

where.label: 推理 · D3 层塔
本页 · 动手试试 ④

terms.def: 冻结模型，只在某一层的隐状态上训练一个线性回归或分类器。读得出来，说明这份信息在那一层是“线性摆放”的。
terms.def_en: Freeze the model and train only a linear regression or classifier on one layer's hidden states. If it can read something out, that information is laid out "linearly" in that layer.

where.label: 世界模型 · 城市探针

terms.def: 某一层输出的向量，也就是残差流在这一层的样子。Qwen3-0.6B 每个位置、每一层都是 1024 维。
terms.def_en: The vector a layer outputs — what the residual stream looks like at that layer. In Qwen3-0.6B it's 1,024-dimensional at every position and every layer.

where.label: 推理 · D3 层塔
世界模型 · 城市探针
